# 100.00 USD borrowed from the director into the USD bank, in a transaction
# stated in USD throughout. Nothing in it is CAD, so nothing derives what the
# USD cost, and the file states it: 1.35 CAD/USD on the bank split, which makes
# that split a cost basis with a balance of its own.
#
# Uses the accounts from fx_usd_bill_cad_expense.txt, and opens the loan.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_spending_what_a_settlement_brought_in.py.
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Director Loan USD
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-02-01 * "Borrow 100 USD from the director"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "100.00"
		cost_basis_cost: "1.35 CAD/USD"
	Liabilities:Director Loan USD -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "-100.00"
